tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: The accounting systems this API key can read (e-conomic, Dinero, Billy …): id, system, company.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: One page of invoices from the accounting system, canonical model (amounts in øre). Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

tools.name: vat_by_quarter
tools.description: Output VAT, input VAT and VAT payable per quarter (øre). From the VAT ledger accounts (incl. input VAT) when journal entries are synced, otherwise from sales invoices only — each quarter says which in `source` (ledger | invoices).

tools.name: profit_and_loss
tools.description: Resultatopgørelse (profit and loss) for a period: revenue and expense lines, result (øre).

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: Bookkeeping proposals waiting for (or past) human review.

tools.name: create_proposals
tools.description: Scan for anomalies and file them as DRAFT proposals in JaKonto for a human to approve. Never writes to the accounting system. Idempotent per open finding.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "vat_by_quarter" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Output VAT, input VAT and VAT payable per quarter (øre) from the synced invoices." → after: "Output VAT, input VAT and VAT payable per quarter (øre). From the VAT ledger accounts (incl. input VAT) when journal entries are synced, otherwise from sales invoices only — each quarter says which in `source` (ledger | invoices)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
